parties.note: Founded in 2000 as an organisation (the Democratic Artsakh Union, which won 20 of 33 seats in June 2000) and as a party on 30 January 2005 (party infobox). Led by Ashot Ghulian (election infoboxes 2005-2020; recorded from 2005). Wikipedia lists national conservatism (centre-right to right-wing). Colour is a neutral placeholder. status_2000 is extra_parliamentary because the year-only founding date may fall after 1 January 2000.

parties.note: The Artsakh branch of the ARF (founded 1890). Won 9 seats in 2000, 3 (with Movement 88) in 2005, 6 in 2010, 7 in 2015 and 3 in 2020. Leader history gives list leaders from election infoboxes (Artur Aghabekyan led in 2015; no person record). Red is the party's official colour.
